display_title: At the End of a Red Moonlit Night
description:
Persecuted by his relatives, Ja-Wun lives a life of poverty. Suddenly, a mysterious plague breaks out in his village, killing many. True to the village legend, the people begin offering up village maidens as human sacrifices. Under pressure from his family, Ja-Wun is forced to take his cousin's sister's place as a sacrifice to the imugi. Trembling in fear, Ja-Wun calls out the name of his childhood friend, a small snake named Sosa. Then, a mysterious man appears before him. Realizing that he is the imugi of the legend, Ja-Wun treats him affectionately, rather than killing him as a sacrifice, and he is reminded of his own little snake, Sosa...

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)
